statement: A positive involution in the full once-punctured-torus loop-outer group has exactly three full profinite section conjugacy classes, each with fixed subgroup having zero first mod-two cohomology. Every cyclic order-four outer action on that punctured-torus group has a homomorphic lift to its actual automorphism group.
where_proved: Part D, statement D.46; work/part_c/d46.tex; code/part_c/torus_order4_lift_d46.py
depends_on: A.2; D.27; D.33; D.43; the full-profinite Brown restriction theorem and the torsion-free finite-index cohomological-dimension theorem
manuscript_passages: Part D(b) of the task; §24, folio 147 verso, scan 293; §30, folios 194–196, scans 383–387; §31, folios 198–199 verso, scans 391–394.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The mod-four cochain, the localized restriction rings, the exact normalizer quotients and the order-four section map are all specified.
notes: The positive square has 2-adic homology matrix minus the identity by D.33. Its two extended characters satisfy chi squared equals u chi by an explicit Bockstein computation. The localized cohomology ring is reduced and three-dimensional; Brown restriction then forces three section classes and vanishing first mod-two cohomology of their full fixed groups. The outer order-four action fixes a class. The corresponding normalizer modulo its central involution cannot be torsion-free, because projectivity would make its maximal pro-two quotient free whereas it is exactly C2. A torsion element gives the actual order-four lift. The proof does not assert that the order-four action is geometrically conjugate or that its remaining mixed orientation signs are excluded.
